'''You're Not Alone''' (German: '''Du Bist Nicht Allein''') is one of the ending themes for the German dub of ''[[M02|The Power of One]]'', replacing {{so|The Power of One}}. It is available on the German release of the [[Pokémon the Movie 2000 (soundtrack)|movie's soundtrack]].
